"""Preserve actual completed main browser captures without rewriting their scope."""
import gzip, hashlib, json, shutil
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path('/home/josh/projects/klem')
def sha(path): return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def archive(path, name):
    target = ROOT / 'docs' / name
    data = Path(path).read_bytes()
    target.write_bytes(gzip.compress(data, mtime=0) if name.endswith('.gz') else data)
    return str(target.relative_to(ROOT))

files = []
for suffix, diagrams, native, producer in [('',24,37,'double-past-prefinal'),('-past',90,99,'past-prefinal'),('-legacy',220,208,'reported-dana')]:
    prefix = '/tmp/klem-double-past-prefinal-main' + suffix
    report = json.loads(Path(prefix+'-browser.json').read_text())
    assert len(report['diagrams']) == diagrams and len(report['native']) == native and report['errors'] == []
    assert len(report.get('exports', report.get('records'))) == 6
    assert report['producer_sha256'] == sha(ROOT/'web/tests'/f'{producer}.mjs')
    for ext in ['-browser.json','-browser.log','-desktop.png','-mobile.png']:
        files.append(archive(prefix+ext,'double-past-prefinal-main'+suffix+ext+('.gz' if not ext.endswith('.png') else '')))

before = json.loads(gzip.decompress((ROOT/'docs/double-past-prefinal-before-api.json.gz').read_bytes()))
actual = json.loads(Path('/tmp/klem-double-past-prefinal-main-browser.json').read_text())
for run in actual['responses']:
    previous = next(r for r in before['runs'] if r['encoding'] == run['encoding'])
    assert previous['request'] == run['request']
    assert len(run['response']['records']) == 181
    for key in ['records','rules','breakdowns','glosses']:
        assert run['response'][key] == previous['response'][key]
    other = dict(run['response']['grammar']); family = other.pop('-었었-')
    assert other == previous['response']['grammar']
    assert [e['id'] for e in family] == ['krdict:68838','krdict:68836','krdict:68840']
owners = json.loads(gzip.decompress((ROOT/'docs/double-past-prefinal-owner-preparation.json.gz').read_bytes()))['complete_native_entries']
assert {r['id']:r['response']['entry'] for r in actual['native']} == owners
for kind in ['source-audit','source-controls']:
    files.append(archive('/tmp/klem-double-past-prefinal-main-'+kind+'.log','double-past-prefinal-main-'+kind+'.log.gz'))
files.append('web/tests/double-past-prefinal.mjs')
report = {'schema_version':1,'state':'main-browser-passed','exit_code':0,
          'sessions':{'double_past':81599,'simple_past':71375,'legacy':82766},
          'scope':'Main debug binaries and built assets; packaged release remains separate. The legacy producer retains its historical prototype flag; this invocation used actual main binaries.',
          'counts':{'diagrams':24,'exports':6,'native_entries':37,'opened_sources':3,'source_frames_per_encoding':181,
                    'simple_past_diagrams':90,'simple_past_exports':6,'simple_past_native_entries':99,
                    'legacy_diagrams':220,'legacy_exports':6,'legacy_native_entries':208},
          'screenshots_inspected':['docs/double-past-prefinal-main-desktop.png','docs/double-past-prefinal-main-mobile.png'],
          'mobile_scope':'390x844 viewport; selected 갔었다 card completely visible; surrounding cards may extend outside the viewport.',
          'owned_server_stopped':{'session_id':38658,'terminal_exit':130},
          'files_sha256':{name:sha(ROOT/name) for name in files},
          'producer':{'text':Path(__file__).read_text(),'sha256':sha(__file__)}}
(ROOT/'docs/double-past-prefinal-main-browser-checks.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
handoff = Path('/tmp/klem-coverage-current-handoff-20261007.json')
data = json.loads(handoff.read_text()); main = data['double_past_prefinal_preparation']['main_integration']
for browser in main['main_browsers']: browser.update(state='passed',exit_code=0)
main['owned_main_server'].update(state='stopped',terminal_exit=130)
main['main_browser_checks']='docs/double-past-prefinal-main-browser-checks.json'
handoff.write_text(json.dumps(data,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print('Archived actual24/90/220 diagrams,18 exports,37/99/208 Native endpoints; pair-only API metadata verified.')
